program.name: Spine Care 35
program.subject: Mobility & posture
program.blurb: Thirty-five minutes for the spine: a flow and control one day, a spine and hip circuit the next.
program.about: Half an hour that keeps the whole spine moving. One day is a flow of waves, bends and twists, then slow control moves; the other a circuit of spine and hip mobility with glute work. They alternate. Both later levels add reps.
program.split: Spine flow & control / spine & hips circuit, 35 minutes
